title: 第17章 大肆收购属性果实第18章 不去当消防员可惜了
slug: 末世我的女人有亿点强
lines: 看着交易界面，林羽的精神力直接点了领取。
【进化点扣除170点！】
提取交易物品需要消耗进化点，这个他早就知道了。
他还担心和他交易的人没有进化点，在挂单的时候直接选了全额支付。
这时候。
在他身前的虚空中，一道空间裂缝出现，一堆果实掉了出来。
林羽伸手一接。
黄色果实3颗，力量丶速度丶体质各一颗。
其他的都是绿色果实，足足有19颗。
“你就是在交易市场挂单的那个人？”
陈静儿看着大圆床上方的空间，突然裂开，掉出了一堆属性果实，被吓了一跳。
“嗯。”林羽没有否认，这没什麽好隐瞒的。
对他来说，没有必要急着去升级，他的实力不惧一阶之下的任何丧尸，升级不是什麽难事。
属性果实才是最珍贵的，用一颗少一颗。而且还是用在0阶的时候，绝对是最划算的。
等他进阶1阶，所有属性翻倍，进2阶再次翻倍，每进阶一次，属性都是翻倍增长。
那麽在0阶的时候，通过属性果实增加的就是比别人额外多出来的，这些属性一次次翻倍增长，最终会很恐怖。
这才是未来和其他人拉开差距的细节，它会随着滚雪球一样越滚越大。
现在末世才第二天，还有极少的属性果实没有被消耗，不趁此机会多收集一点，後面就没有机会了。
在林羽发帖后，不少有实力的人，都学着他在交易市场挂单收购属性果实。
不过他们手中的晶核也不多，没收到几个。
此刻，很多人都意识到了属性果实的重要。
在川市的一所大学里。
女生宿舍中，十几个女生围在一起。
“这个魔术师很不简单啊，我们刚刚还在计划用晶核交易属性果，他就已经行动了。”
“大姐，那我们？”
“既然他开了头，我们也挂单吧，比他的价格低1颗，我们可不像他那样财大气粗。”
这个世界，永远都不缺乏聪明人！
林羽将所有的果实吸收后，属性再度变化。
【代号：魔术师】
【等级：0阶3级0】
content_en:
Looking at the transaction interface, Lin Yu's mental energy directly clicked on receive.
[170 evolution points are deducted! 】
It takes evolution points to extract trading items, which he has known for a long time.
He was also worried that the person he was trading with had no point of evolution and chose to pay in full when placing an order.
This time.
In the void in front of him, a space crack appeared, and a bunch of fruits fell out.
Lin Yu reached out and took it.
There are 3 yellow fruits, one each for strength, speed, and constitution.
The others are all green fruits, 19 in total.
"Are you the one who placed orders in the trading market?"
Chen Jing'er was shocked when she looked at the space above the big round bed. It suddenly opened and a bunch of attribute fruits fell out.
"Yeah." Lin Yu did not deny it. There was nothing to hide.
For him, there is no need to rush to upgrade. His strength is not afraid of any zombies below the first level, so upgrading is not difficult.
Attribute fruits are the most precious, use one and lose one. And it is definitely the most cost-effective when used at level 0.
When he advances to level 1, all attributes are doubled, and when he advances to level 2, they are doubled again. Each time he advances, the attributes are doubled.
So at level 0, what is added through attribute fruits is extra than others. These attributes will double again and again, which will eventually be terrifying.
This is the detail that will separate you from others in the future, and it will snowball and get bigger and bigger.
It's only the second day of the apocalypse, and there are still very few attribute fruits that have not been consumed. If we don't take this opportunity to collect more, there will be no chance later.
After Lin Yu posted his post, many powerful people imitated him in placing orders in the trading market to purchase attribute fruits.
However, they don't have many crystal cores in their hands, and they haven't received a few.
At this moment, many people are aware of the importance of attribute fruits.
In a university in Sichuan City.
In the girls' dormitory, more than a dozen girls gathered together.
"This magician is not simple. We were just planning to use the crystal core to trade attribute fruits, and he has already taken action."
"Sister, what about us?"
"Now that he's started, let's place an order too, one price lower than his. We're not as wealthy as him."
There is never a shortage of smart people in this world!
After Lin Yu absorbed all the fruits, his attributes changed again.
[Codename: Magician]
[Level: Level 0, Level 3, Level 0]
[Magic power: 9300]
【Power: 163】
[Physique: 63]
[Speed: 50]
